description: Four units of a core frame and an extension substream with XBR, X96 and XXCH components.

crosscheck.decode_error: Invalid number of bits for XBR scale factor index

skip.ffprobe_profile: ffmpeg's decoder sets the profile itself when it has decoded a frame (dca_core.c, dca_xll.c), and DTS-HD MA or HRA only after it has decoded the extension, which the stub components do not allow
skip.decode: ffmpeg reads the XBR frame header and its CRC, then rejects the channel set data, which is filler (dca_core.c: 'Invalid number of bits for XBR scale factor index')
